name: lyra-forge
description: Lyra Forge agent plugins for Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: spindle
plugins.description: Inspect, try, compose, verify, and maintain agent skills with exact custody and evidence. Includes the Spindle CLI source and a minimal harness operator.

plugins.name: flip
plugins.description: Teaches your agent custody, grading, and corroboration discipline for research: you direct the work in conversation, flip keeps the durable, auditable notebook. Seven skills covering the notebook lifecycle.

plugins.name: vizier
plugins.description: Steers agents toward good data visualization: pick the chart form from the reader's question rather than from habit, answer the honesty checks a newsroom would ask, and critique a finished chart against 43 documented forms and a corpus of critical writing.

plugins.name: ergo
plugins.description: Teaches your agent to look for what is already known about a dataset before touching it, to record what it learns in a checkable format, and to offer the public-safe part back. One skill covers working with data pages and recovering one from code that already parses the data.

plugins.name: claude-bingo
plugins.description: Generate a bingo board of LLM verbal tics and score it against your local Claude Code transcripts.

plugins.name: yoinker
plugins.displayName: Yoinker — understand it, yoink what transfers
plugins.description: Explains unfamiliar tools and ideas, checks their mechanisms against a real situation, and returns evidence-linked borrow, try, track, or reject decisions without turning recommendation into permission.
